footprints.description: TE Crown Edge socket 6651214, 24 contacts, through hole, 2 rows of 12 on 5.08
footprints.note: Drawing C-6651214 rev A (customer drawing), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/6651214.pdf, sheet 2 (recommended P.C. board layout) and sheet 1. 24 holes: per row 3 groups of 4 at 2.50 pitch (9X 2.50), group start to start 12.90, overall 25.80 first-group-start to last-group-start = 2 x 12.90 (so pad centres span 25.80 + 3 x 2.50 = 33.30); rows 5.08 apart (5.08 TYP BSC). Gap after pad 4 and 8: 12.90 - 3 x 2.50 - 2.50 = 2.90 extra. Pad 1 at 3.20 from the housing end (sheet 1), housing 39.70 long (3.20 + 33.30 + 3.20), 9.03 deep (end view, base width). Hole: finished 1.02 (sheet 3 solder hole, drilled 1.15); the pad diameter is NOT printed, 1.60 assumed (hole + 0.58). Pin numbering (which row carries pins 1-12) is not printed: pins 1-12 on the first row (y -2.54), 13-24 on the second, left to right, assumed. Drawn as printed (view from the board top, rows along x); the board is not edge related.

footprints.description: TE Crown Edge power module 6651170, 4 power contacts of 5 solder tails each, through hole
footprints.note: Drawing C-6651170 rev A (Elcon 285-0102-12100/12300/11300), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/6651170.pdf, sheets 2 and 4; same holes in catalog 1773096 p.177 (4-Position Power Module: 20 x 1.02 plated holes, 22.90 span, 2.90 between groups, 3.33 between rows). 2 segments, 4 power contacts, 20 tails: per row 10 holes in 2 groups of 5 (8X 2.50), group start to start 12.90, so a group spans 10.00 and the pad-to-pad gap between groups is 12.90 - 10.00 = 2.90 + 2.50... (pad 5 to pad 6 = 12.90 - 4 x 2.50 = 2.90); rows 3.33 apart. Each power contact has the 5 tails of one group (the specs note: tails of one contact are one pin): the pin is the group, pins 1 and 2 are the left and right group of the first row (y -1.665), pins 3 and 4 those of the second row (y +1.665): THE PIN-TO-GROUP ORDER IS NOT PRINTED, assumed (all four contacts are power contacts). Pad diameter not printed: 1.60 assumed, hole 1.02 finished (sheet 6 of 6643460 / sheet 4: 40X 1.02 plated through hole). Housing 26.80 x 9.0 (sheet 2; pad 1 is 2.0 from the end, the pads sit 0.05 off centre).

footprints.description: TE Crown Edge power module 6650384, 6 power contacts of 5 solder tails each, through hole
footprints.note: Drawing C-6650384 rev A3 (3 segment, 6 posn power, 286-0052-12101A/12301A), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/6650384.pdf, sheet 4 (recommended PCB layout) and sheet 2; catalog 1773096 p.177 (6-Position Power Module: 30 x 1.02 plated holes, 35.80 span, 3.33 between rows). 30 holes: per row 3 groups of 5 (12X 2.50 = 3 groups x 4 intervals), group start to start 12.90, 25.80 first group start to third group start; groups are 10.00 wide and 2.90 apart; rows 3.33 apart. One contact per group (tails of one contact are one pin): pins 1-3 are the three groups of the first row (y -1.665), pins 4-6 those of the second row; THE PIN-TO-GROUP ORDER IS NOT PRINTED, assumed (all six are power contacts). Pad diameter not printed: 1.60 assumed, hole 1.02. Housing 39.7 x 9.0 (sheet 2: pad 1 is 1.95 from the end: 1.95 + 35.80 + 1.95 = 39.70).

footprints.description: TE Mini Crown Edge power socket 6651712, 6 power contacts of 3 solder tines each, surface mount
footprints.note: Drawing C-6651712 rev C (MC-P3S0), datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/6651712.pdf, sheet 2 (solder land guidelines, socket connector) and sheet 1. 18 SMT lands 2.00 wide: per row 3 groups of 3 at 2.50 pitch (12X 2.50), group-to-group distance of the neighbouring lands 4.00 (4X 4.00), overall 23.00 first to last land: 0, 2.5, 5 | 9, 11.5, 14 | 18, 20.5, 23. Group centres therefore 9.00 apart (pitch 9.0 of the generator row = the middle land of each group). Land length: 2.30 to 4.70 from the centre line (2.30 TYP / 4.70 TYP) = 2.40 long, centred 3.50 from the centre line; the two rows are mirrored about it. One contact per group (3 tines are one pin): pins 1-3 first row (y -3.5), pins 4-6 second row; THE PIN-TO-GROUP ORDER IS NOT PRINTED, assumed. Two locating holes 2X dia 1.100 +-0.025 at +-13.46 (26.92 apart) and y -3.56 (left, first row) / +3.56 (right, second row): 3.56 from the centre line; plating not stated, drawn non-plated (assumed). Housing outline 28.3 x 8.40 (sheet 1), assumed centred on the land layout.

footprints.description: TE HD+ straddle-mount card edge socket 2360411 (2x7 power + 2x10 signal contacts of the 48 positions), 34 pins, pads on both board faces
footprints.note: Drawing C-2360411 rev A, datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/2360411.pdf, sheet 2 (recommended mounting board edge configuration) and sheet 1. The housing straddles the board edge: pads on both faces of the board. Own face pads (P1-P7 = pins 1-7, S1-S10 = pins 15-24) are ordinary, the far face pads (P8-P14 = pins 8-14, S11-S20 = pins 25-34) carry opposite. Coordinates (mm), print dimensions relative to the datum X (the key notch of the board) and datum Y (the board edge): S1 at +1.81 from X, S pitch 1.27, S pad 0.80 wide, S1 to P7 centre 4.77 (so P7 at -2.96), P pitch 5.08, P pad 4.38 wide (4.38+-0.05), P1 at -2.96 - 6 x 5.08 = -33.44; pad lengths: the pads start 0.50 inside the board edge and reach 7.00 (P) / 6.35 (S) from it: P 6.50 long, S 5.85 long (centres 3.75 / 3.425 inside the edge). THE BOARD EDGE IS AT +y OF THE PADS (the pads lie on the board, y negative, the board edge at y = +5.60 and the housing beyond it): y_foot = y inside the board edge - 5.6 means the edge is 5.60 below the origin. The origin is the middle of the 65.5 x 19.00 housing outline (ears, with the hole centres 57.96 apart: x = datum X + 11.14 is the midpoint of the holes at X - 40.12 and X + 17.84; y: the ear hole centre is at the board edge, the housing outline runs 3.9 above it to 15.1 below it). ASSUMED: the far-face pads sit exactly behind the near-face pads (P8 behind P1 ... P14 behind P7, S11 behind S1 ... S20 behind S10): the front view of sheet 1 shows both rows at the same x, but sheet 2 draws the pad layout of one face only. The drawing shows two ear holes dia 3.70 (M3 screw) in the board: not drawn (the board holes are the board's, 3.70+-0.05 at X - 40.12 and X + 17.84). Orientation as printed: the print views the board top (board edge at the bottom, i.e. +y).

footprints.description: TE Mini Crown Edge VRM socket 1766336 (MC-P6S9), 30 contacts (6 power x 3 lands + 9 signal per row), surface mount
footprints.note: Drawing C-1766336 rev C, datasheets/connector-card-edge/te/1766336.pdf, sheet 4 (recommended solder land guideline, as viewed from the connector side) and sheet 3. Per row 15 contacts left to right: power group of 3 lands, 9 signal lands, 5 power groups of 3 lands. x from the left locating hole (96.57 apart, 2X dia 2.44): first land 7.56; first signal land 7.56 + 10.53 = 18.09, signal pitch 2.50 (8X 2.50); second power group 7.56 + 36.07 = 43.63; groups 9.70 apart (2X 9.70: 43.63, 53.33, 63.03), the fifth group at 7.56 + 66.77 = 74.33 (11.30 over the notch), the sixth 74.33 + 9.70 = 84.03; the three lands of a group 2.50 apart (12X 2.50). Power lands 2.00 wide (36X 2.00+-0.05), signal lands 1.02 wide (18X 1.02+-0.05), all 3.75 long (3.75+-0.05 TYP); power land centres 3.10 (3.10), signal land centres 3.38 (3.38) from the centre line; x is relative to the middle of the two holes (48.285). The pin order is NOT printed: pins 1-15 along the upper row (y negative) and 16-30 along the lower row, left to right, one pin per contact (the 3 lands of a power group are one pin), assumed. The locating holes dia 2.44+-0.03 are drawn non-plated (plating not stated). Housing 97.54 (connector length) x 9.03 (sheet 4, the 9.03 reference between the dashed outline), centred on the land layout (assumed).
